text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few months after Narita Taishin's debut, 
two other Umamusume made their debuts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even Narita Taishin recognized the true 
strength of the two who were both her 
friends and her rivals aiming for the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she couldn't afford to lose— To 
prepare for her eventual showdown with 
them, she continued her training again 
today.
